# Duxel

> Duxel is a cross-platform C#/.NET desktop UI library for Windows (Win32) and Linux (X11), with Fluent 2 widgets, retained-mode layouts, and Vulkan rendering. Try it from a .NET 11 file-based app using public NuGet packages.

## Getting started

- [README](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel): Platform support, Gallery launchers, and runnable app examples.
- [Korean README](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/README.ko.md): Korean quick start and desktop examples.
- [File-based apps](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/docs/getting-started-fba.md): Windows and Linux host choices and the shared C# example.
- [Linux and WSLg setup](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/docs/linux-platform.md): X11, Vulkan, fonts, and Linux Gallery launch.
- [Runnable Fluent 2 apps](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/docs/fba-run-samples.md): File-based apps for calculator, notepad, large list, and motion.
- [Fluent 2 YAML preview](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/docs/fluent-dsl.md): Compile multiple YAML views with typed state and C# callbacks, and run the samples from the checkout.
- [Vibe-coding quick start](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel#start-vibe-coding-with-duxel): Use a Gallery example in a first prompt, then verify the change.
- [NativeAOT publishing](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/docs/native-aot.md): Reproduce executable sizes on Windows and Linux.

## Reference

- [API and source map](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/docs/duxel-agent-reference.md): Where to confirm signatures and find working examples.
- [Gallery guide](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/docs/gallery-navigation.md): How to find, try, and copy Gallery examples.
- [Version history](https://github.com/dimohy/Duxel/blob/main/docs/version-history.md): Released package names and platform scope.
